source.note: Unit 5 Grammar 1 (Present progressive: am/are/is + verb-ing, planner pp.170-173) and Grammar 2 (Questions with that and those, planner pp.176-177). No Grammar Workbook answer key was consulted for this unit; charts and samples were built from the planner grammar boxes, Grammar in Depth notes, and practice activity answers.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Present progressive: am / are / is + verb-ing
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'What are you wearing?' about yourself and 'What is he/she wearing?' about someone else. Answer with 'I'm', 'You're', 'He's', or 'She's' plus a verb ending in -ing.
grammarPoints.pattern: What am/are/is + subject + verb-ing? I'm/You're/He's/She's + verb-ing + noun.

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Questions with that and those
grammarPoints.rule: Ask 'What's that?' about one thing far away and 'What are those?' about more than one thing far away. Answer with 'That's + noun' for one thing or 'Those are + noun' for more than one.
grammarPoints.pattern: What's that? That's + noun. / What are those? Those are + noun.

intro_examples.text: What's that? That's my orange T-shirt.
intro_examples.jp: それは何ですか？それは私のオレンジ色のTシャツです。

intro_examples.text: What are those? Those are my purple shoes.
intro_examples.jp: それらは何ですか？それらは私の紫色の靴です。
それは何ですか？それは帽子です。

intro_examples.text: What are those? Those are socks.
intro_examples.jp: それらは何ですか？それらは靴下です。

rules.title: Ask What's that? for one thing far away
rules.jp_title: 遠くの1つのものには 'What's that?'
rules.subtitle: Use 'What's that?' to ask about one thing that is not close to you.
rules.jp_subtitle: 自分の近くにない1つのものについて尋ねるときは 'What's that?' を使います。

examples.jp: それは何ですか？それは私のTシャツです。
それは何ですか？それは帽子です。

rules.title: Ask What are those? for more than one thing far away
rules.jp_title: 遠くの複数のものには 'What are those?'
rules.subtitle: Use 'What are those?' to ask about two or more things that are not close to you.
rules.jp_subtitle: 自分の近くにない2つ以上のものについて尋ねるときは 'What are those?' を使います。

examples.jp: それらは私の紫色の靴です。
